name: Preflight Change Environment
summary: Collect a deterministic redacted environment snapshot before a repository change begins.
description: Runs a local bounded collector that reports runtime, package-manager markers, and redacted git state without emitting paths, environment values, file contents, or remote URLs.
risk_reason: This command collects a deterministic redacted environment snapshot before a repository change begins; it does not claim parity with CI or production from a local snapshot.
refuses: Do not print environment-variable names or values, remote URLs, absolute paths, usernames, or file contents.
Do not install dependencies, change configuration, or repair the environment.
Do not claim parity with CI or production from a local snapshot.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate declared local command preconditions before the prompt workflow may continue.
Collect a bounded redacted environment snapshot without reading environment values or file contents.

produces: a redacted JSON environment snapshot and an explicit list of missing prerequisites

flags.name: scope
flags.description: Restrict follow-up inspection to a user-supplied relative path.

linkReasons.skill/development/testing/verify-complet: to verify completion claims after the change

operational.latency_reason: The command follows a precondition check and multiple workflow steps while it collects a deterministic redacted environment snapshot before a repository change begins.
